data.title: Bitcoin holds near $85,000 as SEC clears first 3x leveraged crypto ETPs
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin hovered near $85,000 on Sunday as investors weighed a new U.S. regulatory development that could expand leveraged exposure to the world’s largest cryptocurrency.
